title_original: Horror ‘The Block’ With Jack Falahee, Saphira Moran & Jackie Earle Haley Wraps; Unveils First Look

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE: Craig Singer ’s horror The Block has wrapped and unveiled a first look at recent Tony award-winning actor Jack Falahee ( Death of a Salesman ) in the starring role of a writer who turns to a chilling source of inspiration.

Falahee plays Mitch James at the top of his career who becomes caught up in a murderous case of writer’s block and a fan-turned-girlfriend (Saphira Moran) obsession that becomes deadly. The movie follows the once-golden boy of horror into a mind-bending exploration of the creative process, locking the protagonist in a never-ending doom-cycle of creation and destruction.

blocks.text: Singer, former Creative VP at Disney, has reteamed with horror-writer Robert Dean Klein , following the success of their award-winning film 6:45 starring Michael Reed, Armin Garo and Augie Duke.

“I’ve been developing The Block for many years,” says director and co-producer Craig Singer. “The original idea – what an artist is compelled to go through to secure their art and legacy – has always intrigued me and feels even more urgent in 2026.

“Today’s rapidly evolving, AI-driven creative landscape forces creators at every level to make artistic choices and face challenges on a scale we’ve never seen. The timing couldn’t be more relevant. The Block isn’t about jump scares; it’s a philosophic fable for our times.”

The ensemble cast of The Block also includes Thomas G. Waites ( The Thing ), Jackie Earle Haley ( Watchmen , Shutter Island ), Catherine Cocoran ( Terrifier ), Chris Noth ( Sex and the City ), Carrie Jo Crosby, Armen Garo ( Dexter: New Blood ), Michael Rodrick ( General Hospita l) and Elias Koteas ( Chicago P.D .).

The film is a co-production between Singer’s US-based production company Cascrator Films , and Australian-based production company Three777 Films which co-produced Beast starring Russell Crowe and recent slasher film The Only One starring Mel Jarnson and Moran.
The film is in post-production and does not yet have a premiere date.
